1.name: Christian Mobile App Meu Maná - Your Pocket Bible
1.description:
Meu Maná is the mobile app that goes beyond Bible reading to nurture a complete faith journey with interactive and transformative spiritual disciplines.

Overview

Christian apps are limited to the Bible as their only feature. Meu Maná innovates with an ecosystem that guides Christians in spiritual growth through prayer, fasting, testimonies, and reflections, in a light and interactive way.

Key Features

Offline Bible Library: Nine complete JSON translations for offline reading, navigation, bookmarks, and image sharing, with instant version switching.

AI Spiritual Assistant: Sabedoria, powered by Groq Llama 3.1 8B with streaming and cache. Trained to guide spiritual disciplines, it recognizes the user, suggests app modules, and responds from a specific knowledge base.

Disciplines Ecosystem: Fasts with timer, background prayer alarms, intercessions, and testimonies with references. Synced via Supabase with offline queue.

Advantages

Offline First Architecture: Operations queue locally and sync to Supabase when online, essential for users with intermittent connectivity.

Contextual AI: Sabedoria knows the user and the app, following the ministry’s theology. Streaming and redundant keys ensure fluidity on slow connections.

Hybrid Monetization and Premium Design: RevenueCat manages two-tier subscriptions, Start.io displays ads for free users. Glassmorphism, gradients, custom fonts, and dark mode deliver a premium experience.

Meu Maná inspires Christians to organize their spiritual disciplines and have a guided journey with purpose.

Source code is proprietary to InoveTech and is not publicly available.

2.name: Vector Learn - Vector Learning Platform
2.description:
Vector Learn is an open-source interactive educational platform that teaches vector mathematics with 3D simulations, gamification, and free content for STEM students.

Overview

Vector education has been dominated by abstract formulas, leaving students without geometric intuition. Vector Learn fills this gap by transforming abstractions into interactive, tangible experiences.

Key Features

2D and 3D Simulators: 2D canvas with real-time sliders and Three.js scene with orbit controls allow students to manipulate vectors and visualize operations instantly, developing concrete geometric intuition.

Gamification System: progression engine with XP, levels, streaks, badges, and QR-coded PDF certificates. Progress persists in the browser without registration.

ENEM Question Bank: over 60 real college entrance exam questions with timed test mode, radar performance charts, and exportable PDF reports.

Advantages

Ease of Learning: the visual and interactive approach reduces the friction between theory and understanding, allowing students to grasp complex concepts in minutes. Over 20 students have already benefited and use the platform daily in their vector studies.

Premium Mobile Experience: responsive layout with swipe gestures, Vaul-powered bottom sheets, haptic feedback, and zen mode for distraction-free study, all optimized for mobile where most students access the platform.

Free Course: from vectors on the plane to line integrals, with applications in machine learning, computer graphics, and physics, 100% free.

Vector Learn changes how you see vectors: from equations on a page to tools you can see, manipulate, and apply. The platform is constantly evolving with innovative contributions from the community.

3.name: Enjoy Brasil Tourism Mobile App
3.description:
Enjoy Brasil transforms how tourists discover, plan, and experience travels across Brazil with artificial intelligence.

Overview

Planning a trip through Brazil requires dozens of sources: outdated guides, scattered reviews, and generic search engines. Enjoy Brasil eliminates this noise with an ecosystem that plans itineraries, recommends places, and connects travelers intelligently.

Key Features

AI Assistant Zé Turi: Chatbot that creates personalized itineraries by destination, days, and budget. A complete trip planner in the app.

Traveler Connection Feed: Social feed with curated tabs that aggregates multimedia posts, itineraries, and reviews. Likes, comments, and shares create an active community around tourism.

Gamification: 15 levels with rarity badges, missions, and leaderboard. Every interaction earns points and achievements, turning exploration into an engaging experience.

Advantages

Native Experience: Animations on the native thread with Reanimated and Skia rendering. Every transition feels like a true native app.

Contextual Notifications: Custom notification engine for welcome, reminders, social interactions, and profile verification. Each notification arrives at the right moment.

Native Multilingual: Portuguese, English, and Spanish with automatic detection and PT-BR fallback. Every screen and notification is translated without manual setup.

Your next travel guide is not a map app. It’s Enjoy Brasil.

Source code is proprietary to InoveTech and is not publicly available.

4.name: InoveTech Institutional Website
4.description:
InoveTech is the corporate website of the software house InoveTech, which transforms visitors into leads and presents its portfolio with excellence.

Overview

Recently founded, InoveTech had no digital presence worthy of its potential. Without a professional website, it lost credibility and opportunities. It needed a showcase that communicates its value proposition, displays cases, and generates leads.

Key Features

Interactive Portfolio with Real Cases: Three projects (Enjoy Brasil, Meu Maná, AME) are presented with mockups, tech stack, and a dedicated page with a screen gallery, proving the company’s competence.

Structured Lead Capture Form: Complete form with name, company, project type, and deadline, sent via EmailJS with a unique lead ID trackable in the sales funnel.

R.E.D.E. Methodology with Visual Demonstration: Four steps presented with an interactive before/after slider that transforms an abstract concept into concrete evidence for the visitor.

Advantages

Experience that Sells: Animations with Framer Motion and GSAP, SPA routing with View Transitions, and three-language support create a fluid navigation.

Portfolio with Real Results: The three cases have applications published on Google Play and App Store, with functional links and detailed tech stack that prove end-to-end delivery.

SEO and Organic Reach: Specialized semantic markup helps search engines understand and highlight the site in results, while intelligent loading delivers speed on any device. The result is a site found by clients in Brazil and worldwide.

Every section, animation, and component was designed to convert visitors into leads. This site does not just represent InoveTech, it sells.

Source code is proprietary to InoveTech and is not publicly available.

5.name: Dolce Amore Confectionery Menu
5.description:
Dolce Amore Confectionery is a descriptive menu that translates the art of pastry chef Thais Nascimento into objective and affectionate information, guiding customers in choosing the perfect sweet for their celebrations.

Overview

Dolce Amore had an unprofessional menu that failed to convert customer interest into actual orders. I worked together with the brand to restructure a completely new menu with clear prices, organized categories, and purchase conditions that build trust and drive decisions.

Key Features

Custom Budget for Author Cakes: Customers describe their cake vision via contact channels, ensuring artistry and premium ingredients are accurately priced.

Price Catalog by Size and Yield: Diameters from 12cm to 22cm with exact slice yields and fixed prices for instant cost-benefit calculation.

Detailed Guide to Flavors and Decorations: Cake bases, fillings, and decorative items organized with clear surcharges and starting prices for full autonomy.

Advantages

Transparency and Accuracy: Per-slice yield, clear lead times, and down payment terms eliminate surprises, reducing cancellations and rework.

User-Centered Architecture: The narrative introduces the pastry chef before products, humanizing the brand, while a checklist guides customers from doubt to action.

Conversion Through Sensory Design: Textures and affections with names like "Moranguinho" turn the menu into a silent salesperson that increases order closing rates.

Dolce Amore now has a menu that does not just display products, it converts lookers into buyers and questions into orders.

6.name: GoRango Admin Panel - MVP
6.description:
GoRango Admin is an MVP of an administrative panel for GoRango, a multi-category delivery system that unifies partners, delivery drivers, orders, and finances in Brazil.

Overview

Brazilian merchants lack an integrated platform to manage deliveries. This MVP delivers the core of GoRango for restaurants, markets, and pharmacies to control orders, track delivery drivers, and view metrics, validating the proposal.

Key Features

Order Management and Operations: Unifies the order lifecycle with filters, search, and export. Delivery drivers use gamification with Bronze to Diamond levels, proving engagement.

Monitoring and Analytics: Leaflet map displays partners and delivery drivers. Revenue and volume charts are complemented by conversion, retention, and NPS metrics.

Financial Management and Marketing: Visibility over GMV, take rate, and commissions with PDF and CSV reports. Campaigns with ROI, coupons, and the GoClub program test monetization and loyalty.

Advantages

Fast Validation: Modern technologies deliver a professional experience with a customizable theme and AI-assisted development that sped up prototyping and reduced time between iterations, accelerating user validation.

Architecture Ready for Scale: The system loads content on demand with speed. Server communication is ready for real use, swapping test data for real data without starting over.

Built-in Regulatory Compliance: LGPD on the frontend with a cookie banner and privacy pages eliminates regulatory risk from the first delivery.

In a market where every minute of delay costs customers, GoRango Admin proves it is possible to deliver real value with a solid MVP before scaling.

Source code is proprietary to InoveTech and is not publicly available.

7.name: Landing Page and Members Area for CRE 2026
7.description:
Conferencia Rios do Espirito and its digital ecosystem unite a landing page with an exclusive portal for Christian event participants.

Overview

Religious events often lose contact with their audience after ticket sales. I, as a volunteer from the Media and Communication department of Igreja Verbo da Vida Cabula, helped avoid this problem by building two products: a sales landing page and a restricted site for attendees.

Key Features

Landing Page with Sales: Site with video, countdown timer, 3D carousel of ministers, schedule, map, FAQ, and tickets integrated with Tiketo. Built to rank on Google and convert visitors.

Restricted Attendee Site: Portal where conference attendees access official photos, full recordings, playlists, and the WhatsApp group throughout the entire event, from day one.

Feedback and Testimonials: Attendees rate what they liked and what can be improved, and share testimonials about their conference experience.

Advantages

Pre-to-Post Journey: The ecosystem delivers a continuous experience: purchase through the landing page and access to the restricted portal starting from the first day of the conference.

Complete and Professional Product: Two sites with a unique visual identity, logo, palette, and exclusive typography. The landing page sells the event dream, and the portal delivers content only attendees deserve to have.

Ease of Access: Over 300 people used the application from landing page to exclusive site. No install, no account creation, just click the link and go. Everything works directly in the browser, on mobile or desktop.

Conferencia Rios do Espirito is born digital to live beyond the event days.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Common questions about career, services, technology, and budget. Click each question to see the answer.

items.career_1_q: What does a fullstack developer do?
items.career_1_a: A fullstack developer designs and builds complete digital solutions, working on both the frontend (visual interface) and backend (logic, databases, and servers). Carlos Neto is a Fullstack Developer and Designer capable of creating mobile apps, institutional websites, landing pages, and web platforms from scratch to deploy: including design, Figma prototyping, responsive development, and API integration. This versatility reduces costs and deadlines since a single professional oversees the entire project from concept to delivery.
items.career_2_q: What's the difference between a designer and a developer?
items.career_2_a: A designer creates visual solutions for many formats: visual identity, social media creatives, menus, cards, banners, branding, and also website and app interfaces. A developer turns those creations into functional products through code. Carlos Neto masters both skills: he creates visual design of any kind in Figma, Canva, or Illustrator, and also develops the product using technologies like React, Vue.js, React Native, and Supabase. This integration eliminates communication friction and ensures the final result matches the original design.
items.career_3_q: Is Carlos available for new projects?
items.career_3_a: Yes, Carlos Neto is available for new freelance projects including web development, mobile apps, interface design, and digital consulting. His current availability status is displayed at the top of the site. To hire him, simply reach out via the contact form, WhatsApp, or email to discuss your idea and receive a custom proposal.
items.services_1_q: What's the difference between a landing page and an institutional website?
items.services_1_a: A landing page is a single, conversion-focused page: ideal for marketing campaigns, product launches, or lead capture. An institutional website is a set of pages (home, about, services, blog, contact) that presents a company completely and professionally. Carlos Neto develops both: landing pages starting at $300 USD and complex institutional websites starting at $700 USD, always with responsive design and basic SEO included.
items.services_2_q: Is it worth creating a mobile app for my business?
items.services_2_a: Yes, if your business needs continuous engagement, push notifications, offline functionality, or integration with device features (camera, GPS, payments), a mobile app is the best path. Carlos Neto develops apps for iOS and Android simultaneously using React Native and Expo, reducing cost and development time. Simple apps start around $2,000 USD, while complete solutions can reach $5,000+. He also builds MVPs to validate your idea before heavy investment.
items.services_3_q: Does a professional website need SEO?
items.services_3_a: Yes, SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is essential for any professional website that wants to be found on Google. Carlos Neto applies technical SEO to every project: semantic markup, optimized meta tags, fast loading, structured data (JSON-LD), and relevant content. An SEO-optimized website attracts organic visitors continuously, reducing dependence on paid ads and delivering long-term results for your business.
items.services_4_q: How does the website creation process work?
items.services_4_a: The process follows 5 stages: 1) Discovery: meeting to understand the business, target audience, and goals; 2) Prototyping: Figma design with client approval; 3) Development: responsive programming with modern technologies (Vue.js, Nuxt, or React); 4) SEO and testing: search engine optimization and multi-device validation; 5) Deploy and support: server publication and ongoing maintenance. Average timeline is 2 to 4 weeks for institutional websites.
items.tech_1_a: A responsive website automatically adapts to the screen size of any device: mobile, tablet, or desktop. With over 60% of internet traffic coming from mobile devices, having a responsive site isn't optional: Google prioritizes mobile-friendly sites in search results, and users abandon sites that don't work well on phones. Carlos Neto develops all projects with a mobile-first approach, ensuring a consistent experience on every screen.
items.tech_2_q: React Native or Flutter: which is the best choice?
items.tech_2_a: React Native and Flutter are the leading hybrid mobile development technologies. Carlos Neto prefers React Native with Expo for three reasons: mature and stable ecosystem, native integration with services like Supabase and RevenueCat, and the ability to share logic and components with web React projects. But he also works with Flutter if the client prefers, ensuring flexibility in choosing the ideal technology for each project.
items.tech_4_q: How is artificial intelligence being used in development?
items.tech_4_a: Artificial intelligence is being integrated into apps and websites in many ways: intelligent chatbots for customer support, virtual assistants with natural language processing, personalized recommendations, task automation, and predictive data analysis. Carlos Neto has developed AI solutions including spiritual assistants with Llama 3.1 and tourism chatbots, integrating APIs like Groq, OpenAI, and Claude into real products published on app stores.
items.budget_1_a: Payment is split into two stages: 65% at project start and 35% upon final delivery. This division ensures security for both client and developer.
items.budget_2_q: How long does it take to develop a website or app?
items.budget_2_a: Simple landing pages and websites: 1 to 2 weeks. Complete institutional websites: 2 to 4 weeks. Mobile apps: 4 to 12 weeks, depending on complexity. The timeline is defined in the proposal's schedule, and the client receives weekly progress updates. Carlos Neto works with agile methodologies, allowing adjustments during the process without compromising the final deadline.
